note: Acceptance manifest for `python -m nctool acceptance run` (scripts/analysis/README.md, 'Acceptance'): what each encoding must be when decoded without nc. The cases are benchmark.json's `benchmark_set` (destination blocks), re-targeted at each `inputs` entry; nothing here lists a case. Bounds are per encoding and in the units each oracle names. A JPEG bound is measured on these fixtures with about 25% headroom and is not a codec contract; a lossless one is the encoder's contract.

chart.note: The synthetic chart (nctool.chart): a neutral ramp, saturated and muted patches, so the patch and cross-encoding oracles have content. It is a generated file, so its input semantics are asserted.

lut_note: The coded-HDR profiles' curves are 1024-entry tables, so near black their A2B0 departs from BT.2100 by up to ~0.07 cd/m²; the LUT bound's absolute term (in reference-white units) is 0.1 cd/m².

film-master.oracle: the file's f32 ACEScg against the canonical buffer; the encoder writes it verbatim, so the bound is tighter than the spec's 2e-6

sdr-tiff.oracle: the standard transfer of the canonical linear buffer, quantized to 16 bits, against the stored codes

hdr-linear-tiff.oracle: the file's f32 against the canonical buffer; the encoder writes it verbatim

hdr-pq-tiff.oracle: BT.2100 PQ of the canonical buffer (1.0 = 203 cd/m²) in binary64, quantized to 16 bits, against the stored codes; the profile's A2B0 against BT.2100 on a grid of codes

hdr-hlg-tiff.oracle: BT.2100 HLG of the canonical buffer for a 1000 cd/m², zero-black display (inverse OOTF, gamut pull, OETF) in binary64, quantized to 16 bits, against the stored codes; the scene-referred A2B0 against the inverse OETF on a grid of codes

gain-map-jpeg.oracle: metadata against the renditions; the map's gains at its own grid against the renditions' gains; both JPEGs against their pre-JPEG codes; the end-to-end reconstruction reported

cross_encoding.note: Patch means decoded to XYZ D65 with reference white at Y = 1, against the reference case's. `untouched` patches are gated; every other patch is tone- or gamut-mapped somewhere and its hue and chroma deltas are reported. `bounds` is the spec's; an 8-bit encoding cannot reach it (8-bit quantization alone reaches ΔE00 0.52 on the chart), so `allowances` pins a measured bound per encoding.
